description:
Folded into fz-kdt.34.

Formula identity, dependency-revision causality, output changes, and downstream wakes are scheduler-owned facts. They will be exposed once through the generic reactive-cell telemetry contract in fz-kdt.34, not through an activation-specific observation path.

fz-kdt.13 consumes that generic signal to correct activation-analysis cell boundaries. No independent implementation remains here.
title: Expose activation-cell identity and revision causality in public telemetry
